summary: RopeSlice equality sliced UTF-8 strings using another chunk's byte length, which can fall inside a multibyte character in the compared string and panic. The fix compares byte slices, permitting arbitrary byte offsets. The proposed reversal restores only RopeSlice-to-RopeSlice equality. The fix-added integration test tests/non_ascii_comparison.rs::non_ascii_eq compares lines containing non-ASCII text after removing characters 1467..1827. No tests were executed.
